TOP SECRET                 KRELLAN FLEET HEADQUARTERS                 TOP SECRET
                           ==========================                           
                              INTELLIGENCE REPORT                               
               FOR REGIONS IN LEVEL 1 OF THE UGA INVASION SECTOR                
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
INTERSTELLAR SPACE HAZARDS                                                      
 . There are no interstellar space hazards reported in these regions.           
                                                                                
OUR FORCES                                                                      
 . There are no enemy warships in this region, so you will be acting alone with 
   just the support of supply ships. Try to establish as many bases as possible.
                                                                                
INHABITANTS                                                                     
 . Native inhabitants have been detected only up to Tech Level 5 (Medium: Early 
   Nuclear Civilization). There will be no native planetary shields or defenses.
                                                                                
ENEMY FORCES                                                                    
 . UGA have occupied some planets in these regions. If the planet has planetary 
   shields or defenses, then it will be a UGA planet. Avoid sending landing     
   parties to the surface of these planets because they could be trapped if     
   the planetary shields are raised.                                            
 . These regions are considered peaceful frontiers and no UGA warships have     
   been detected - only unarmed UGA freighters and starliners. They are not     
   expecting an invasion, so it should be a happy hunting ground.               
 . It appears the UGA only has one starbase in each of these regions.
